ITEM 1 | Mixed salad greens, dark green and purple-tinged leaves with lighter green ribs, loosely piled in the upper left of the plate, spanning roughly 10 cm across and about 2 cm tall, slightly wilted, matte with no dressing sheen | 35

ITEM 2 | Scrambled eggs, pale yellow with soft curds and some darker golden edges, flowing slightly and partly covered by sauce, occupying roughly 9 cm by 6 cm on the right side of the plate, about 2 cm tall, moist-looking | 90

ITEM 3 | Red tomato-based sauce, thick, glossy and smooth, spooned over the center-right of the eggs and spreading into a pool of about 7 cm by 6 cm, with thin runny streaks running down toward the plate edge, slightly sheened | 45

ITEM 4 | Cooked sausage pieces, round patties or coin-shaped slices about 2.5 cm across and 1 cm thick, golden-brown with darker browned edges and a speckled grey-green interior texture, slightly glossy from fat, clustered in the lower center of the plate and covering roughly 12 cm by 8 cm, about 16 pieces | 150

ITEM 5 | Small dark red-orange smears and drips of sauce along the lower right edge of the plate, thin and glossy, scattered beside the sausage pieces | 10
